verdict: Paid campaigns have been dark for 13 days; restoring them is the priority.
narrative: Meta advertising stopped running on August 6th and has produced zero spend and zero leads in the 13 days since — the paid lead pipeline is currently severed. The 28-day totals (44 leads at $24.88 per lead) reflect the active period earlier in the window, not where things stand today. On the organic side, Google Business Profile engagement fell 55% this past week, though website sessions are up 52% week-over-week, showing that residual interest in your firm is real even without paid support. Campaigns are being reactivated, and the immediate focus is restoring paid lead flow before that organic interest goes unmonetised.
